scripts.check: node --check scripts/*.mjs && node --check scripts/lib/*.mjs && python3 -c "import ast,pathlib;[ast.parse(p.read_text(),filename=str(p)) for p in pathlib.Path('scripts').glob('*.py')]" && python3 scripts/validate-workflow.py
scripts.test: node --test && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py'
